articles.summary: Gianna left Uber Eats and DoorDash so she could control how many burritos RITOS sells each day, without giving up delivery. Here’s how her one-woman NYC breakfast burrito business runs on Hotplate, and how it’s grown from one daily menu into curated collabs.
articles.title: How RITOS delivers breakfast burritos across NYC with Hotplate
